[[File:DianogaEye-ANH.png|thumb|right|250px|The single eyestalk of a dianoga]]
An '''ommatophorum''' or '''eyestalk''' was a biological feature by which an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was distanced from the body to provide a better field of view. Numerous [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient [[Species/Legends|species]] had eyestalks.
